title: Keep the demand, add support
statement: For learners who are behind, keep the task's demand and add support, such as guided reading, vocabulary support and targeted practice, instead of giving easier material.
detail: A pedagogy framework's guidance for students behind grade level says not to lower the cognitive demand of material but to scaffold it (`icloud-work/incept/incept-uae-api-website/bench.inceptapi.com/Incept Pedagogy & Learning Science Overview.md`). It is a rule of the framework, with no measurement in the project.
against: A later run found counter-evidence (`othello-archive/sources/Year 9 ELA- Lesson Design Specification for Devfactory.txt`). A later run found counter-evidence (`g9/library/text/L9b6d99.txt`).
